description: Clean UVs on a noisy rock: a displaced sphere roughened with fine noise and decimated to irregular triangles, like a scanned, decimated or generated rock. Unwrapped as it is, xatlas shatters it into about 90 ragged charts; chart_smoothing 60 cuts and flattens the charts on a smoothed copy and puts the uv on the real shape, which gives 9 smooth charts at one texel density. Rendered with the persp view shaded by a uv checker and the uv view.
